answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 13 epochs old, anchored at a yarrow checkpoint. The wander chain is verified at intake and sable publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 13 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 17 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
